value.text:
We need to check each claim against the evidence. Let's go through each claim.

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-6625-35 is on the FDA shortage list as "Unavailable" with FDA reason category "Other", manufacturer reports manufacturing delay, next delivery January 2027, estimated recovery March 2027." Cited evidence: shortage-0409-6625-35. The evidence says exactly that: availability "Unavailable", FDA reason category "Other", next delivery January 2027, estimated recovery March 2027, manufacturer reports Manufacturing Delay. So claim is supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 308 units covers 16.8 days at 18.4 units per day." Cited stock-11. Evidence: "308 units on hand, 18.4/day over 30 days, 16.8 days of cover". Matches.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited search-recall-11. Evidence: "no ongoing recall." Supported.

Claim 4: substitution: "Current sodium bicarbonate 84 mg/mL (ANDA202432) has 16.8 days of cover." Cited stock-11. Evidence shows 16.8 days of cover. Supported.

Claim 5: substitution: "ANDA219701 is therapeutically equivalent to current product (both TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited ob-ANDA202432-001, ob-ANDA219701-001, status-ANDA219701. Evidence: ob-ANDA202432-001 shows TE code AP for current. ob-ANDA219701-001 shows TE code AP for ANDA219701. status-ANDA219701 says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list. So supported.

Claim 6: substitution: "ANDA217523 is therapeutically equivalent to current product (both TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited ob-ANDA202432-001, ob-ANDA217523-001, status-ANDA217523. Evidence: ob-ANDA217523-001 shows TE code AP. status-ANDA217523 says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list. Supported.

Claim 7: substitution: "ANDA219089 is therapeutically equivalent to current product (both TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited ob-ANDA202432-001, ob-ANDA219089-001, status-ANDA219089. Evidence: ob-ANDA219089-001 shows TE code AP. status-ANDA219089 says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list. Supported.

Claim 8: substitution: "ADAPTIS PHARMA PRIVATE LTD ANDA219701: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) to current product and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited status-ANDA219701, ob-ANDA219701-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, ndc-83854-001, ndc-68462-951. The claim is essentially same as claim 5 but with extra NDC evidence. The evidence supports therapeutic equivalence and shortage status. The NDC records show packages but not needed. Supported.

Claim 9: substitution: "AMNEAL EU LTD ANDA217523: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) to current product and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited status-ANDA217523, ob-ANDA217523-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, ndc-80830-2305. Supported.

Claim 10: substitution: "MILLA PHARMACEUTICALS INC ANDA219089: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) to current product and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited status-ANDA219089, ob-ANDA219089-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, ndc-71357-004. Supported.

All claims appear supported. No unsupported claims. So output empty list.

But we must be careful: The claim 8 says "ADAPTIS PHARMA PRIVATE LTD ANDA219701: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) to current product and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." The evidence includes status-ANDA219701 which says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list. That's correct. The NDC records are just additional. So supported.

Thus unsupported list empty.

We'll output {"unsupported":[]}.</think>{"unsupported":[]}
